a7681047: What is the first tool you are advised to craft in Minecraft?
The wooden pickaxe is the first essential tool: it lets you mine stone and move on to stone tools, which are far more efficient.
2d5a683e: Which common block resists TNT and Creeper explosions?
Obsidian is one of the most blast-resistant blocks you can get in survival. It is also used to build Nether portals.
cc945cc9: What is the name of the final boss of the End dimension?
The Ender Dragon is Minecraft's final boss: you have to destroy the End crystals that heal it, then deal enough damage to defeat it.
edca8f58: Which resource do you need to build a Nether portal?
Obsidian is needed to build a Nether portal: you form a frame of at least 4×5 obsidian blocks, then light it with flint and steel.
a8ebf91f: Which hostile mob explodes when the player gets close?
The Creeper is Minecraft's iconic enemy: it sneaks up silently and explodes, destroying buildings and killing the player. Players have dreaded it since 2009.
a5fa0734: Which material, introduced in 1.16, beats diamond for tools and armor?
Netherite comes from ancient debris found in the Nether since 1.16. Netherite gear is the best in the game and survives fire and lava.
a46c3bbf: What is the lowest depth of the world (since 1.18)?
Since Minecraft Java 1.18, world generation goes down to Y=-64, opening up the deepslate layer and the Deep Dark.
c1e7aa8a: Which neutral mob attacks when you look it in the eyes?
The Enderman is a neutral mob that turns hostile when you look straight at it. It can teleport and move blocks. Looking at its feet avoids an attack.
fe85873d: What is the name of the hellish dimension inhabited by Ghasts and Piglins?
The Nether is Minecraft's hell dimension, with netherrack, fortresses, bastions and mobs such as Ghasts, Blazes and Piglins.
1d112984: What are powered rails crafted from?
Powered rails are crafted from gold ingots, a stick and redstone. They speed up minecarts and are essential for long rail lines.
ebeda129: Which biome is the least likely to generate in Minecraft?
Mushroom Fields are among Minecraft's rarest biomes: often isolated in the ocean, they spawn no hostile mobs naturally. A perfect sanctuary to build in.
b3b3d5bc: What happens when you feed two animals of the same species their favorite food?
Feeding two compatible animals their favorite food triggers love mode: hearts appear and a baby is born. It is Minecraft's basic breeding system.
1d9968c0: How many inventory slots does the player have by default?
The player has 36 inventory slots: 27 main slots and 9 hotbar slots, plus 4 armor slots and an off-hand slot.
2405a7ea: What is a mob farm in the game?
A build that exploits spawning mechanics to collect drops easily
A mob farm exploits mob spawning mechanics: by controlling the spawning environment (darkness, height), the player can automatically collect rare drops.
a731e787: Which unique item appears when you defeat the Ender Dragon?
The Dragon Egg appears on top of the exit portal after the first victory over the Ender Dragon. It is purely decorative.
be4a1df3: What is the name of the update that overhauled cave generation (1.18)?
Caves & Cliffs (1.17-1.18) completely reworked cave generation: cheese caves, spaghetti caves, the Deep Dark and a world going down to Y=-64.
c7b10a11: What is the name of the guardian of the ancient cities in the Deep Dark biome?
The Warden guards the Deep Dark: a blind mob that tracks by sound and vibration. It is extremely powerful, and even netherite won't protect you for long.
f8856866: What is the crafting recipe for a torch?
A torch is crafted from a stick and coal or charcoal. Essential for lighting in survival, it prevents hostile mobs from spawning and helps you explore.
511e3d73: A component that compares or subtracts redstone signals
The redstone comparator can compare two signals or subtract one from another. It can also measure how full a container such as a chest is, which is essential for complex circuits.
aea70ba1: What is the underwater structure protected by Guardians called?
The ocean monument is a prismarine structure guarded by Guardians and three Elder Guardians. Eight blocks of gold are hidden at its heart.
62d9ba5a: Which Minecraft mechanic lets you travel 8 times faster over long distances?
1 block in the Nether equals 8 blocks in the Overworld: a network of Nether portals lets you cross thousands of Overworld blocks quickly.
79696fe9: Which ingredient is used to brew a Potion of Healing?
The glistering melon slice, made from a melon slice and eight gold nuggets, is the ingredient for the Potion of Healing.
7acac7a9: What is the value that determines random terrain generation in each new world called?
The seed is the value that determines world generation: sharing a seed with another player generates exactly the same world. Some seeds are famous for their rare structures.
a0991b5e: Which item do you use to tame a wolf into a pet dog?
Bones tame wolves, each with about a one-in-three chance of success. A tamed wolf wears a red collar, follows the player, fights for them and can be told to sit.
a66d4d69: What is the name of the underwater boss guarding Ocean Monuments?
The Elder Guardian protects ocean monuments, with three per monument. It inflicts Mining Fatigue, which slows mining drastically.
ee414cc2: Which item repairs elytra on an anvil?
Elytra wear out in flight and are repaired on an anvil with phantom membranes. Phantoms appear at night when the player hasn't slept for several days.
ffb371eb: What is the durability of a diamond pickaxe in Minecraft Java?
A diamond pickaxe has a durability of 1,561 uses; netherite is a little sturdier with 2,031. Unbreaking III makes it last much longer.
795749b5: Which materials do you need to craft a bed in Minecraft?
A bed is crafted from 3 wool blocks of the same color and 3 wooden planks. It lets you skip the night and set your spawn point, and sleeping keeps Phantoms away.
2576f2f6: How long is a day-night cycle in Minecraft?
A full cycle lasts 20 real minutes: about 10 minutes of day, 7 minutes of night, and a sunrise and sunset of a minute and a half each.
11ae88ee: How do you gain experience (XP) in Minecraft?
By killing mobs, mining certain ores or smelting
XP comes from killing mobs (the main source), mining valuable ores (diamond, emerald, lapis), smelting or trading with villagers. It is used to enchant or repair on the anvil.
c5e820a2: Unbreaking gives a chance that the tool won't lose durability with each use. Mending, on the other hand, repairs the item with experience you pick up.
9c647512: Which block gives off light even underwater and is crafted from prismarine?
The sea lantern is crafted from prismarine shards and crystals, found in ocean monuments. It gives off the maximum light level, even underwater.
0078686b: Which boss do you summon by placing three wither skeleton skulls on soul sand arranged in a T?
The Wither is summoned with four soul sand blocks in a T topped by three wither skeleton skulls. When defeated, it drops a Nether Star, used to craft a beacon.
c58fa6e1: Which crimson-red Nether biome is filled with giant fungi?
The Crimson Forest is a crimson Nether biome with giant fungi, home to Hoglins and Piglins. The Warped Forest is its teal counterpart.
950ce781: Which item helps you locate special structures in Minecraft?
Explorer maps, sold by cartographer villagers for emeralds, show the location of structures such as ocean monuments or woodland mansions.
9773d379: Which boot enchantment lets you walk on water by freezing it?
Frost Walker turns water into frosted ice under your feet, letting you walk across water without swimming. The ice melts again after a few seconds.
c4c553b8: Which neutral mob attacks in a swarm if you break its nest without calming it first?
Bees, added in 1.15, attack and poison you if you break their nest. A campfire placed underneath calms them so you can harvest honey safely.
406045dc: What is the name of the update that overhauled villages and added pillagers?
Village & Pillage (Java 1.14, 2019) overhauled villages and added illagers (Pillagers, Ravagers, Vindicators), along with raids triggered by the Bad Omen effect.
be0cc829: Which enchantment gives you more items when mining (for example, diamonds)?
Fortune III can give up to four diamonds per ore. Silk Touch, on the other hand, collects the ore block itself.
1d70643d: How do you make netherite to upgrade your diamond armor and tools?
Smelt ancient debris, then combine 4 scraps with 4 gold ingots
Smelted ancient debris gives netherite scrap. Four scraps and four gold ingots make an ingot, which upgrades diamond gear at a smithing table (with an upgrade template since 1.20).
4cd5fbad: Which bow enchantment in Minecraft means you never run out of arrows (one is enough)?
Infinity stops arrows from being used up: a single arrow is enough for thousands of shots. In Java Edition, Infinity and Mending cannot be combined.
5f837d3a: What is the Minecraft Education feature that lets you program with code blocks?
Code Builder is a Minecraft Education feature that lets students control an in-game agent with block-based code, JavaScript or Python.
f7076f9b: Which Nether mob walks on lava and can be ridden with a saddle?
The Strider walks on lava. With a saddle and a warped fungus on a stick, the player can ride it across lava lakes.
c0c590e1: Which rare structure in the Overworld contains the portal to the End?
The stronghold is a rare underground structure holding the End portal, which must be activated with 12 eyes of ender. Defeating the Ender Dragon completes the main game.
e6ab0300: Which mob drops string, useful for crafting bows?
Spiders drop string, used to craft bows, fishing rods and tripwires.
7143197b: What effect does the Looting enchantment have on mobs?
More drops, and better chances of rare ones
Looting increases mob drops: Looting III adds up to three extra items and raises the chance of rare drops. Especially handy on Blazes for blaze rods.
aac6c392: What is the name of the underwater biome with colorful coral?
The Warm Ocean contains coral reefs, with tube, brain and other coral blocks. Tropical fish and pufferfish live there.
654fbfb6: What is the recipe for an Ender Chest?
8 obsidian blocks around 1 eye of ender make an Ender Chest, whose contents can be reached from any Ender Chest in the world. Perfect for keeping valuables safe.
4c909e3e: Which Minecraft animal can be tamed with raw fish to become a companion?
Stray cats in villages can be tamed with raw fish. They scare Creepers away, which makes them precious guardians.
089b8c3f: Efficiency speeds up mining of blocks suited to the tool. Efficiency V is the maximum and makes mining nearly instant on the right blocks, especially combined with Haste II from a beacon.
5dfef3de: Which mob spawns in witch huts in swamps?
The Witch lives in witch huts in swamp biomes. She throws harmful potions (poison, slowness) and drinks defensive ones. Witches can spawn elsewhere too, but the hut is their home.
79ed836c: What is the rare jungle structure with traps and treasure called?
The jungle temple is a stone structure hidden in dense vegetation, with tripwire traps, hidden dispensers and two treasure chests protected by mechanisms.
6c1988a4: What do you need to craft a beacon?
A diamond block + a Nether Star
A beacon is crafted from 5 glass, 3 obsidian and 1 Nether Star (dropped by the Wither). It must sit on a pyramid of mineral blocks to give area effects.
bb1191cc: What effect does a Potion of Strength give the player?
The Potion of Strength increases melee damage: Strength I adds 3 damage per hit, Strength II adds 6. Very useful against bosses like the Wither.
eb30513b: What do you need to activate a portal to the End?
End portal frames with eyes of ender
The End portal is made of End portal frames already present in the stronghold: you place 12 eyes of ender in the frames to activate it. Strongholds are found by throwing eyes of ender.
827872f2: Which tool do you need to mine obsidian?
Only a diamond or netherite pickaxe
Only a diamond or netherite pickaxe can mine obsidian, and it takes about 9.4 seconds even with diamond. An iron or gold pickaxe yields nothing.
c64d0b4e: Which status effect triggers a raid when the player enters a village?
A player with Bad Omen who enters a village triggers a raid: waves of pillagers, ravagers and evokers attack.
d74c60f8: At what height is it often recommended to mine for diamonds since 1.18?
Since 1.18, diamonds are most common near the bottom of the world. Mining around Y=-58 finds plenty while staying above the bedrock.
fd994271: What is Spectator mode in Minecraft?
A mode where you fly freely and pass through blocks without interacting
Spectator mode lets you fly freely through the world, passing through blocks and entities without interacting: handy for exploring structures without changing them or watching other players.
4240d9bf: Where in the End dimension can elytra be found?
Elytra are found in the End ships moored at some End cities, which are defended by Shulkers. There is only one pair per ship.
0e4dd8fa: What is the name of the status effect that drastically slows mining?
Mining Fatigue is inflicted by the Elder Guardians of ocean monuments: Mining Fatigue III makes mining nearly impossible. It lasts 5 minutes and keeps coming back while an Elder Guardian is alive.
